chunks: My father, may Allah have mercy on him, narrated to us, saying: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Sulayman ibn Sama'a, from his paternal uncle 'Asim al-Kuzi, from Abu Abdillah, from his father, peace be upon them both, who said:

The Prophet, Allah's blessings be upon him and his Family, said: Perform additional prayers during the hour of unawareness, even if by two light rak'as, for indeed, they are a cause of (acquiring) the Home of Dignity. It was said: O Messenger of Allah, and when is the hour of unawareness? He said: Between the (prayers of the) sundown and the evening.

key_terms.دَارَ الْكَرَامَةِ: The Home of Dignity (a reference to Paradise)
key_terms.سَاعَةُ الْغَفْلَةِ: Hour of unawareness (a specific time for voluntary prayer)

ai.seo_question: What is the 'hour of unawareness' and what is the reward for praying during it?
ai.summary: In *Mani al-Akhbar*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this hadith linking the 'hour of unawareness' (sā'at al-ghafla)—specifically the interval between Maghrib and 'Isha—to a period where worldly distractions wane, making it an optimal time for spiritual reflection. The Prophet’s instruction to perform even two light voluntary rak'as during this window underscores the Shia emphasis on seizing moments of quietude to earn the 'Home of Dignity' (Dār al-Karāma), highlighting the transformative power of consistent, humble devotion.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	We were told by my father, may Allah grant him mercy, that he said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Muhammed bin Khalid, from Sulayman bin Sama’a, from his paternal uncle, ‘Asim al-Kuzi, from Abu Abdillah, from his father, peace be upon them both, that he said:

The Prophet, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Family, said: Perform additional prayers during the hour of unawareness, even if by two light rak’as, for indeed, they are a cause of (acquiring) the Home of Dignity. It was said: O Messenger of Allah, and when is the hour of unawareness? He said: Between the (prayers of the) sundown and the evening.
